Strategy: Add an exact-fit bonus and a four-more-items bonus on top of the gentle fifteen sweet band and mid penalty. This rewards three kinds of good leftovers at once, but the overlapping bonuses may blur the ranking and the limits are guesses.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) + (15 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) + (10 if r - item >= 4 * item and r - item < 5 * item else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
